events.title: Novi Dems Canvass Kickoff & Club Photo
events.location: Novi Civic Center | 45175 W 10 Mile Rd, Novi, MI 48375, USA | Novi | MI | 48375
events.description: Join us in a HUGE Canvass Kickoff and Club Photo on Saturday, September 19 at 10:00 on the south side of the parking lot behind the Novi Civic Center, 45175 W 10 Mile Rd, Novi, MI 48375. MEET INSIDE CIVIC CENTER IF IT IS RAINING. PHOTO WILL BE TAKEN PROMPTLY AT 10:15!!! Please wear your Novi Dems shirt, or dress in club colors of white & blues. Candidates, please bring campaign signs and literature. CANVASSERS: PLEASE ARRIVE AT 9:30 to pickup a turf and get canvassing instructions. If you are able, join us immediately afterwards to canvass for ALL of our endorsed candidates! Training provided; new canvassers will be paired with someone experienced for on-the-job training. You may also pickup a turf to walk sometime during the week.

events.title: September Membership Meeting
events.location: The Hawk Community Center | 29995 W 12 Mile Rd, Farmington Hills, MI 48334, USA | Farmington Hills | MI | 48334
events.description: Join us for our General Membership Meeting. Social hour is at 6:30 and the meeting starts at 7:00. We will have a guest speaker and a current elected official provide a legislative update. Come meet fellow Democrats and find a way to get involved! We will meet in the Meeting Room on the 3rd Floor of The Hawk Community Center located at 29995 W 12 Mile Road, Farmington Hills MI 48334. The 3rd floor is accessible by the Upper Parking Lot on the back side of the building, or via elevator from the main entrance.

events.title: Knock Oakland: South Oakland Canvass
events.description: Join the Oakland County Democratic Party for an afternoon of action as we hit the doors and connect with voters across South Oakland County! 📅 Thursday, September 24 ⏰ 4:00–7:00 PM 📍 Launch Location: OCDP Headquarters We’ll meet at OCDP Headquarters for a quick kickoff before volunteers head out to knock doors in targeted neighborhoods throughout Southfield, Royal Oak/Royal Oak Township, Ferndale, and Hazel Park. Whether you’re an experienced canvasser or knocking doors for the first time, we want you with us! Training, turf, and canvassing materials will be provided. Come ready to talk with voters, build connections, and help us organize across Oakland County. 👟 Wear comfortable shoes 📱 Bring a fully charged smartphone 👥 Bring a friend — canvassing is always better with a partner! Every door. Every conversation. Every community. Let’s Knock Oakland!

events.title: Power in The Precinct; The MI Precinct Delegate & Grassroots Assembly!!
events.description: POWER IN THE PRECINCT The Michigan Precinct Delegates & Grassroots Assembly Get ready for a high-energy, action-packed statewide gathering bringing together Precinct Delegates and Grassroots Leaders from across Michigan! This Assembly is designed to train, connect, educate, and prepare you to organize in your precinct and community. 🔥 WHAT TO EXPECT: 🎤 SUPERSTAR GUEST SPEAKERS Hear from special guests and movement leaders who are doing the work and shaping the future of Michigan. 🗳️ INTENSIVE PRECINCT DELEGATE TRAINING Learn what it means to be a Precinct Delegate, what is expected of you, how to organize your precinct, build relationships with voters, and turn your position into grassroots power. 📣 PROP 1 & MOP BALLOT INITIATIVES Hear directly from special guests about Proposal 1 and MOP ballot initiatives, what they mean, and how grassroots leaders can educate and engage their communities. 🤝 GRASSROOTS CONNECTION & NETWORKING Connect with Precinct Delegates, organizers, activists, and grassroots leaders from across Michigan. 💪 STRATEGY + ACTION This isn't just a gathering to listen. We're coming together to learn, strategize, organize, and leave ready to take action. ALL PRECINCT DELEGATES & GRASSROOTS LEADERS ARE INVITED TO CONVENE. 📅 Saturday, October 24th 🕛 12 PM – 5 PM 📍 Westside Detroit Area
